text:
Rhea (Marketing): FYI planning a joint benchmark announcement with OpenScale next Friday 10:00 AM PT. Theyve requested coordinated press release and single embargo. Need partner approval, legal signoff, and joint exec quotes by Tue EOD. @Ishan can you confirm partner timeline?

Ishan (Partnerships): OpenScale confirmed tentative approval; they want to run one final data check Mon morning. Theyre also asking to preview the embargoed press kit. Ill DM the contact and request their finalized quote.

Vik (Product): Uploaded benchmark chart and test notes to /marketing/assets/joint-bench-v1.png. Footnote drafted: "Benchmarks run on our joint harness across x86 GPUs; quantization applied when noted. Results may vary by workload."

Hannah (Legal): Will review the joint statement and the partner contract clauses about publicity. Two asks: 1) avoid comparative superlatives, 2) add a co-branding logo spec in the kit.

Sam (PR): Proposed schedule: embargo 9:30 AM PT, press release + blog at 10:00 AM PT, coordinated tweets from both companies at 10:05 AM PT. I'll draft the embargoed email and the joint press release. Need partner contact list and logo assets.

Rhea (Marketing): Checklist: partner signoff (Ishan), legal (Hannah), joint exec quotes (Ishan/Sam), chart asset (Vik), logo + brand guidelines (OpenScale), PressOps job. Also we should add a short FAQ in the kit about methodology.

PressOps Bot: Publish job created: channel=marketing/blog, publish_at=2026-07-24T17:00:00Z, embargo_until=2026-07-24T16:30:00Z, job_id=120331.

Ishan (Partnerships): OpenScale will send logo files and final quote by Mon 15:00 PT. They requested a brief 2-hour preview window before we share with press.

Hannah (Legal): Ive added co-branding clause and removed the phrase "outperforms" from the draft. Please use neutral language and reference the appendix for test details.

Sam (PR): Drafted embargoed release and DMd to Ishan. Holding outreach until partner signs the press clearance form. Also proposing a joint webcast next week; want to gauge interest.

Vik (Product): Updated chart to /marketing/assets/joint-bench-v2.png after partner feedback. Methodology FAQ added to /marketing/shared/methodology-faq.md.

Rhea (Marketing): Nice work. Once partner signoff is in, Hannah please post legal thumbs-up. Sam will finalize press list. PressOps Bot please keep job pending until we get partner clearance.

PressOps Bot: Job 120331 set to pending. React :play: to resume when all approvals received.

Ishan (Partnerships): Partner clearance received at 2026-07-20T14:52:00 PT. Sending signed clearance now.

Hannah (Legal): :thumbsup: legal confirmed on joint release and co-branding.

Sam (PR): Final press list shared: TechCrunch, The Verge, Protocol, The Register, VentureBeat. Holding embargoed sends until Rhea confirms publish timing.

Rhea (Marketing): All set. Resuming job now. PressOps Bot please un-pause and publish per schedule. Also coordinating internal announce and partner comms. :rocket:

PressOps Bot: Job 120331 resumed. Scheduled publish remains 2026-07-24T17:00:00Z.
